dev_notes: src/render/markdown.mjs; the three docs are the three audience/dev_notes combinations. Titles, intros and the colophon are overridable per project under `docs` in config.json — see src/wording.mjs.

history.name: Three Markdown documents for the team
history.description: The command ledger build also writes three Markdown documents from the same corpus: FEATURES.md, the client-facing list; FEATURES_EXTENDED.md, the same list with implementation notes under each entry; and DEV_FEATURES.md, the entries only the team sees. All three describe the latest release, so they read as what the product does today. They are build output: the corpus is what you commit, and it carries the documentation's history on its own.

The command ledger build also writes three Markdown documents: the client-facing list, the same list with implementation notes, and the entries only the team sees, with how to see each entry. They describe the latest release and are build output.
history.how_to_see: Run ledger build --md and open FEATURES.md in the docs folder: an entry with how to see it prints it under its description.

events.what: The Markdown documents print how to see each entry under its description.
events.why: A description can raise the question of which part of the platform it is about, and saying how to see each entry answers it consistently.
